one_chunk_per_request.rule: TRN-5: a replay request holds exactly one log record

no_content_encoding.rule: 8.1: no Content-Encoding on a replay request (the body is compressed by the format layer)

chunk_attributes.rule: RPL-13: every MUST attribute of 11.3 is present and typed; no ouo.replay.ref (RPL-14)

body_size.rule: a chunk body is at most 1 MiB

hash_and_size.rule: RPL-12: ouo.replay.sha256 and ouo.replay.byte_size match the body received

body_decodes.rule: the body decodes (gzip when ouo.replay.encoding says so) and every line is JSON with `t` and `type`; ouo-video/1: encoding identity, a header line and a well-formed mp4

sequence.rule: per stream the sequences are 0, 1, 2, ... with no gap

keyframe.rule: the first chunk of each segment has keyframe=true and starts with a `frame` event (`video` for ouo-video/1, where every chunk is a segment)

ended.rule: RPL-20, RPL-26: one ouo.replay.ended per finished stream, MUST attributes present, last_sequence is the highest sequence seen
